description: This PHP class defines the Location entity for the OrangeHRM system. It models a location with properties such as name, country, province, city, address, contact information, and notes. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Entity class representing a geographic location within the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, relationships, and associated getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the location.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the location.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Gets the Country object associated with this location.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a Country object with this location.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Retrieves the province/state information.

methods.name: setProvince
methods.description: Sets the province/state information.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city name of the location.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city name of the location.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address details.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address details.

methods.name: getZipCode
methods.description: Returns the zip/postal code.

methods.name: setZipCode
methods.description: Sets the zip/postal code.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Gets the phone contact number.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the phone contact number.

methods.name: getFax
methods.description: Retrieves the fax number.

methods.name: setFax
methods.description: Sets the fax number.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns additional notes about the location.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets additional notes about the location.
